# netbox_virtual_chassis_master (Resource)

Sets the master device of a virtual chassis. The device must be a member of the chassis (its virtual_chassis_id). Import with the virtual chassis id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_site" "test" {
  name = "test-site"
}

resource "netbox_manufacturer" "test" {
  name = "test-manufacturer"
}

resource "netbox_device_type" "test" {
  manufacturer_id = netbox_manufacturer.test.id
  model           = "test-device-type"
}

resource "netbox_device_role" "test" {
  name = "test-device-role"
}

resource "netbox_virtual_chassis" "test" {
  name = "test-stack"
}

resource "netbox_device" "member1" {
  name                     = "test-switch-1"
  device_type_id           = netbox_device_type.test.id
  role_id                  = netbox_device_role.test.id
  site_id                  = netbox_site.test.id
  virtual_chassis_id       = netbox_virtual_chassis.test.id
  virtual_chassis_position = 1
}

resource "netbox_device" "member2" {
  name                     = "test-switch-2"
  device_type_id           = netbox_device_type.test.id
  role_id                  = netbox_device_role.test.id
  site_id                  = netbox_site.test.id
  virtual_chassis_id       = netbox_virtual_chassis.test.id
  virtual_chassis_position = 2
}

resource "netbox_virtual_chassis_master" "test" {
  virtual_chassis_id = netbox_virtual_chassis.test.id
  device_id          = netbox_device.member1.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device_id` (Number) Id of the member device to make the chassis master.
- `virtual_chassis_id` (Number) Id of the virtual chassis.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The virtual chassis id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# The id of the virtual chassis.
import {
  to = netbox_virtual_chassis_master.test
  id = "123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The id of the virtual chassis.
terraform import netbox_virtual_chassis_master.test 123
```
